steps.description: 运行对话路径测试脚本

params.code:
## 对话路径运行时测试脚本
##
## 由 MCP 客户端调用 godot-mcp-pro.execute_game_script 执行。
## 调用前：play_scene mode=main 让游戏处于运行态。
##
## 功能：
##   - 遍历指定 NPC 的所有对话路径
##   - 注入游戏状态以解锁条件分支
##   - 验证对话内容和状态变化
##   - 输出结构化测试结果
##
## 输出格式：每行 key=value
##   - npc_id=<npc_id>  : 当前测试的 NPC
##   - node_id=<node_id>: 当前测试的节点
##   - status=PASS/FAIL/SKIP : 测试结果
##   - message=<message> : 详细信息
##   - path_count=<count> : 已测试路径数
##   - error_count=<count> : 错误数
##   - TEST_COMPLETE : 测试完成标记

extends RefCounted

var _gm = null
var _dm = null
var _path_count: int = 0
var _error_count: int = 0
var _tested_nodes: Dictionary = {}

func _run() -> void:
	_gm = get_node("/root/GameManager")
	_dm = get_node("/root/DialogueManager")

	if _gm == null or _dm == null:
		_mcp_print("FAIL=missing_autoload")
		return

	_mcp_print("case_id=" + _gm.ACTIVE_CASE)

	# 测试所有 NPC
	var npc_ids = _get_npc_ids()
	_mcp_print("npc_count=" + str(npc_ids.size()))

	for npc_id in npc_ids:
		_test_npc_dialogue(npc_id)

	_mcp_print("path_count=" + str(_path_count))
	_mcp_print("error_count=" + str(_error_count))

	if _error_count == 0:
		_mcp_print("TEST_STATUS=PASS")
	else:
		_mcp_print("TEST_STATUS=FAIL")

	_mcp_print("TEST_COMPLETE")


func _get_npc_ids() -> Array:
	"""获取所有有对话数据的 NPC"""
	var npc_ids = []
	var dialogue_data = _gm.get("dialogue_data")
	if dialogue_data == null:
		# 尝试从 CaseTableLoader 获取
		var case_id = _gm.ACTIVE_CASE
		# 这里需要根据实际的数据结构调整
		# 暂时返回已知的 NPC 列表
		npc_ids = ["agui", "fisherman_wang", "lao_fan", "li_zheng", "shen_qingyue", "zhou_wife"]
	else:
		for npc_id in dialogue_data.keys():
			if not npc_id.begins_with("_"):
				npc_ids.append(npc_id)
	return npc_ids


func _test_npc_dialogue(npc_id: String) -> void:
	"""测试单个 NPC 的对话树"""
	_mcp_print("npc_id=" + npc_id)

	# 重置游戏状态以确保干净的测试环境
	_reset_game_state()

	# 注入所有可能需要的状态以解锁所有分支
	_inject_all_states()

	# 开始对话
	_dm.start_dialogue(npc_id)

	# 等待对话开始
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout

	# 遍历对话树
	_traverse_dialogue_tree(npc_id, "hub", 0)

	# 结束对话
	_dm.end_dialogue(true)  # 抑制助手旁白

	_mcp_print("npc_complete=" + npc_id)


func _reset_game_state() -> void:
	"""重置游戏状态"""
	_gm.reset_progress()
	# 等待状态重置完成
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout


func _inject_all_states() -> void:
	"""注入所有可能需要的状态以解锁所有对话分支"""
	# 注入所有 flags
	var all_flags = [
		"agui_talked_once",
		"wang_talked_once",
		"fan_talked_once",
		"li_zheng_talked_once",
		"shen_qingyue_talked_once",
		"zhou_wife_talked_once",
		"agui_dismissal_confronted",
		"agui_bladder_confronted",
		"fan_alibi_contradiction",
		"confrontation_triggered",
		"agui_confessed_mastermind",
		"clue_fan_alibi_hole",
		"clue_secret_meeting",
		"clue_reef_common_knowledge",
		"clue_fan_boat_skill",
		"lie_exposed:agui.press_alibi",
		"lie_exposed:lao_fan.press_route",
	]

	for flag in all_flags:
		_gm.set_flag(flag)

	# 注入所有证据
	var all_evidence = [
		"evidence_dismissal_note",
		"evidence_float_bladder",
		"evidence_wrong_channel",
		"evidence_hull_hole",
		"evidence_gambling_iou",
		"evidence_salvage_mark",
		"evidence_anonymous_note",
	]

	for evidence in all_evidence:
		_gm.add_evidence(evidence)

	# 注入所有线索
	var all_clues = [
		"clue_fan_alibi_hole",
		"clue_secret_meeting",
		"clue_reef_common_knowledge",
		"clue_fan_boat_skill",
	]

	for clue in all_clues:
		_gm.add_clue(clue)


func _traverse_dialogue_tree(npc_id: String, node_id: String, depth: int) -> void:
	"""递归遍历对话树"""
	if depth > 20:  # 防止无限递归
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "SKIP", "max_depth_exceeded")
		return

	var node_key = npc_id + "." + node_id
	if _tested_nodes.has(node_key):
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "SKIP", "already_tested")
		return

	_tested_nodes[node_key] = true
	_path_count += 1

	# 跳过系统节点
	if node_id in ("__exit__", "__confront__"):
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "SKIP", "system_node")
		return

	# 选择当前节点的选项
	var options = _get_current_options()
	if options.is_empty():
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "FAIL", "no_options")
		_error_count += 1
		return

	# 测试每个选项
	for i in range(options.size()):
		var option = options[i]
		var goto = option.get("goto", "")

		if goto == "" or goto == "__exit__" or goto == "__confront__":
			_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "PASS", "exit_option")
			continue

		# 选择选项
		_dm.choose_option(i)

		# 等待对话更新
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout

		# 验证状态变化
		_verify_state_changes(npc_id, node_id, option)

		# 递归遍历下一个节点
		_traverse_dialogue_tree(npc_id, goto, depth + 1)

		# 返回上一级（如果需要）
		if depth > 0:
			_dm.choose_option(0)  # 假设第一个选项是"返回"
			await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout


func _get_current_options() -> Array:
	"""获取当前对话节点的选项"""
	var current_node = _dm._current_tree.get("nodes", {}).get(_dm._current_node_id, {})
	return _dm._filter_options(current_node.get("options", []))


func _verify_state_changes(npc_id: String, node_id: String, option: Dictionary) -> void:
	"""验证状态变化"""
	# 检查 set_flags
	var set_flags = option.get("set_flags", [])
	for flag in set_flags:
		if not _gm.has_flag(flag):
			_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "FAIL", "flag_not_set:" + flag)
			_error_count += 1

	# 检查 gain_evidence
	var gain_evidence = option.get("gain_evidence", "")
	if gain_evidence != "" and not _gm.has_evidence(gain_evidence):
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "FAIL", "evidence_not_gained:" + gain_evidence)
		_error_count += 1

	# 检查 gain_clue
	var gain_clue = option.get("gain_clue", "")
	if gain_clue != "" and not _gm.has_clue(gain_clue):
		_report_node(npc_id, node_id, "FAIL", "clue_not_gained:" + gain_clue)
		_error_count += 1


func _report_node(npc_id: String, node_id: String, status: String, message: String) -> void:
	"""报告节点测试结果"""
	_mcp_print("node_test=" + npc_id + "." + node_id)
	_mcp_print("status=" + status)
	_mcp_print("message=" + message)


func _mcp_print(msg: String) -> void:
	print(msg)
